articles.title: Prediction: Qualcomm Becomes the Top Auto Chipmaker in 2027, “a Story the Market Has Quietly Ignored,” per SemiAnalysis
articles.summary: Key TakeawaysQualcomm’s (QCOM:NASDAQ) auto revenue reached $2 billion in its September quarter, up 89%, and SemiAnalysis predicts it will pass Infineon (IFNNY) and NXP Semiconductors (NXPI:NASDAQ) in 2027 to become the largest auto chipmaker. The growth comes from more Qualcomm content in each car, so it doesn’t depend on car sales.
